entries.description: Give a text product or model, quantity and must-have specs. SeekAPI screens China B2B shop listings for three distinct qualified supplier candidates with source-linked observed price and MOQ, specification fit, exclusions and unknowns on a successful check. Free Product Brief preparation is available; the 2.99 USDC paid run is closed. Listing prices are not current quotes and shop identity is not verified manufacturer identity.

nextAction.scope: one confirmed RFQ, up to three selected suppliers, one authorized human outreach round, 72-hour response window; no guaranteed replies
